sloka: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत् परम अर्थवित् ।प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो हनूमन्तम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-३-१॥।।
transliteration: sugrīvasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetumat parama arthavit ।pratijagrāha kākutstho hanūmantam atha abravīt ॥6-3-1॥।।

translations.english: Rama the scion of Kakuthsa dynasty having accepted the wellmeaning words of Sugriva, who spoke the truth with deep understanding, turned to Hanuman and said.
